Definition: Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Zuph or Zophai = "honeycomb"; n pr m; 1) a Kohathite Levite, ancestor of Elkanah and Samuel; n pr loc; 2) a district northwest of Jerusalem where Saul encountered Samuel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
